maintenance_led.reason: Mostly RectorSeal, TRUaire and Shoemaker HVAC/plumbing products for contractors, plus new-build Balco and Smoke Guard; lubricants are the smaller segment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private HVAC/plumbing contractors, distributors, and industrial, rail and energy firms, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Regularly buys niche brands such as Falcon Stainless, Aspen, Dust Free, PSP Products, PF WaterWorks and Deacon to grow.

mission_critical.reason: Mostly contractor products sold through distributors on brand and availability; contractors can switch brands easily despite some specified fire-rated products.

notes: The text gives no segment revenue split; Contractor Solutions is assumed to be the largest segment.
